[[Protection Prayers]] | icon = Ghostly Staff }} [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]]. == Stats == :[[Energy]] +10 :[[Holy damage|Holy Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]]) :Holy Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Healing Prayers]]) :Holy Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Smiting Prayers]]) :Holy Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Protection Prayers]]) :[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) :[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of spells during [[Special event|Festival events]]. (Chance: 20%) No effect in [[PvP]]. :[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer :[[Health]] +30 :Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend. ==Skin== This staff shares its [[skin]] with the [[Ghostly Staff]]. ==Replica== This item cannot be replicated, as the universal "20% chance of halving casting time of spells" mod is not available outside of the unique Decade weapons. ==Notes== *Is the only Divine Favor staff that deals holy damage. Divine Favor staves usually deal [[fire damage]]. *Like other equipment with multiple attribute requirements, the damage property will count once no matter how many different requirements are met. *The inherent bonus [[HCT]] effect during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]). ==Trivia== *Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422|April 22, 2015 update]]. {{Decade weapons nav}} [[Category:Decade weapons|Staff]] [[Category:Unreplicable unique items]] [[Category:Multiple attribute items]]
